title: t27c on tnf17.t27 -- a 17-bit ternary-exponent float, native
desc: t27c on the t27c lab (Railway), spec at t27 5ff0ec512: 34 tests pass natively; negating with OR instead of XOR fails exactly one test, the involution; git restores the spec.
commands: t27c gen specs/numeric/tnf17.t27 > tnf17.zig && zig test tnf17.zig
sed -i 's/return (x ^ (1 << TNF_SIGN_SHIFT));/return (x | (1 << TNF_SIGN_SHIFT));/' specs/numeric/tnf17.t27 && git diff -U0 | tail -n 2
